## Reviews
- **Code review — pass.** Read the complete diff against `repo-manager`, then exercised every targeted production module with a destructive mutation. The Node project's old boundaries remain intact, the DOM project imports production exports rather than copies, and all four mutations failed at the intended assertion. No correctness finding remained. See `evidence/reviews.txt` and `evidence/mutation-probe.txt`.
- **Security review — pass.** The task adds no runtime endpoint or permission and keeps CI at `contents: read`. The safe-text assertion proves HTML-looking repository content is not executed. `npm audit --json` reported zero vulnerabilities across production and development dependencies. See `evidence/reviews.txt` and `evidence/full-verification.txt`.
- **Simplification review — pass.** One Vitest config owns both environments and one small fixture owns the browser shims. Cytoscape is neither mocked nor started in jsdom: pure model construction is automated and geometry remains a real-browser check. No removable abstraction or duplicate implementation was found. See `evidence/reviews.txt`.

## Deviations from plan
- The plan did not name a jsdom major. The implementation pins `^26.1.0` rather than the latest major because Reggie declares Node 20 support and current jsdom requires a newer runtime. The selected line supports Node 18 and newer.
- The generated instruction files were added to the plan on `repo-manager` before they were refreshed, then that plan commit was merged into the task branch. Their repository census changed when the four new test files landed; leaving them stale would have failed the documented completion gate.

## Discovered issues
- none

## Open risks
- jsdom cannot establish Cytoscape geometry or responsive paint correctness. The in-app-browser run covered the repository and Data Flow pages at 1600px and 390px, including a map hide/show/Fit cycle, canvas sizing, overflow, and console output; a future browser or Cytoscape change would still be caught in that manual lane rather than by these DOM tests.
- Pull request 16 passed both hosted GitHub jobs on `ubuntu-latest` and `macos-latest`. See `evidence/hosted-ci.txt`.
